# CodeEditTextView vendored for Foundry

Upstream: https://github.com/CodeEditApp/CodeEditTextView

Snapshot: tag `0.12.1`, commit `d7ac3f11f22ec2e820187acce8f3a3fb7aa8ddec`.

The upstream MIT license is in `LICENSE.md`. This is CodeEditSourceEditor's native text-view core. The upstream SwiftLint build plugin was removed from this local package manifest so app builds do not require plugin approval.
